ResizeMemStreamTest: Not a game.
Release 1 / Serial number 210726 / Inform v6.36, compiler options S
Interpreter version 0.6.1 / VM 3.1.3 / game file format 3.0.0

A voice booooms out: Welcome to the test chamber.

This tests a memory-pointer bug in Glulxe (which has also been imported into Git, because it's in glkop.c). If a char array is held open while memory is resized, the underlying realloc() may yank the memory map out from under the array. (Examples of an open char array: an open char memory stream or an open char line input request.) This can result in writing to random memory and corrupting the (libc) heap.

This bug should be fixed in Glulxe 0.5.0 and later.

Opening a unichar stream. This should not fail even on old interpreters.
Resizing to 8960...
Chars written: 4: 88 89 90 87
Opening a char stream. This will probably fail on older interpreters.
Resizing to 9984...
Chars written: 4: 120 121 122 119

Test passed.
